_meta.purpose: AI image generation prompts for species page placeholder images still needed. Use with DALL·E, Midjourney, or similar. Match vegetation and animal realism.
_meta.vegetationContext: MIWESU Game Farm, Makoppa district, Thabazimbi, Limpopo. Arid Sweet Bushveld: reddish-brown soil, dry golden-brown grass, patchy green grass, acacia-like trees (flat-topped, thorny), gnarled dark-bark trees, thorny shrubs, dense bushveld thickets, dry season savanna. Warm natural light. No power lines or man-made objects in frame.
styleRules: Realistic, typical specimens only. Do not request 'largest', 'biggest', 'trophy', 'exceptional', 'magnificent' or show-stopper animals.
Healthy, normal-condition animals: not emaciated, not sick, not diseased. Not dying or stressed.
Match Makoppa vegetation and ground: red-brown soil, dry golden grass, acacia thorn trees, bushveld shrubs.
Warm wildlife photography palette. Shallow depth of field where appropriate. No blood, no gore. Dignified.
Golden hour or soft overcast preferred for wildlife. Food/venison: natural lighting, appetising but not staged.
